descriptions.notStarted: I heard there's a rumor that the Baby Dragons can be evolved. Unfortunately, the only way to find out is to meet up with the grotesque-looking Karnox. I better go see him...
descriptions.inProgress: I better protect the Dragon's egg from the vicious egg hunters such as Lupins and Cold Eyes and need to gather #b50Lupin's Bananas#k and #b50 Cold Eye Tails#k.
descriptions.completed: Thankfully, Karnox acknowledged my true love for the Baby Dragon and promised to help my pet evolve.
